title: nf-zeta-quadratic
objective: Implement complex Riemann zeta, Kronecker characters, and complete quadratic Dedekind zeta internals with tests.

handoff.summary: Implemented ordinary-Python Project 1 internals: exact fundamental-discriminant/radicand policy, a Kronecker symbol and direct mixed-radix primitive character constructor with no character enumeration, arbitrary-precision Riemann-zeta/deflated-jet/xi reference policy with an injected FLINT provider contract, and a complete quadratic DedekindZetaFunction product route with precision-aware Dirichlet-L caches, Leibniz derivatives, residues, deflated Taylor coefficients, field-normalized completion/xi, functional-equation reflection at negative integers, scalar/batch evaluation, and tiled real/complex plotting protocols. Added a focused CPython suite covering both discriminant signs, poles and near-poles, derivatives, completion, functional equations, conjugation, batching, plotting, and the even-denominator Kronecker regression.
risks: This lane intentionally does not modify shared baselib hooks, lazy-module registries, pyrightconfig, package manifests, or native architecture inventories; the internals are not public until integration wires them.

The mpmath completion path is a numerical midpoint reference. Production completion should use a native completed-factor provider when one is added, or a precision-preserving ComplexField coercer; it is not a rigorous Arb enclosure.
The lane-required broad pnpm test:native gate was not run because the integration coordinator requested avoiding concurrent broad native builds.
next_steps: Integrate a Riemann provider around riemannZetaJet(nativeComplex,firstOrder,count,deflate,prec), riemannZetaValues(nativeComplex[],prec), and 2*riemannXiStandardValue(nativeComplex,prec); convert every returned native Complex into the requested ComplexField.

Add DirichletLFunction.values using dirichletLValues(group,index,nativeComplex[],derivative,prec). DedekindZetaFunction.values and both plot protocols will then use packed factor batches without scalar native crossings.

Add thin public hooks for arbitrary-complex builtins.zeta, kronecker_character, and NumberFieldParent.zeta_function; pass the native Riemann provider and a precision-preserving result coercer/completed provider. Register the three lazy modules for strict Pyright and production precompilation.
Wire Project 3 methods using zeta_coefficients, dirichlet_series, and euler_product providers, then run integrated native, docs, architecture, and four-platform gates.
